Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a genetically encoded photo-crosslinker (BpA) to identify interaction partners. While not a traditional TPP (Thermal Proteome Profiling) assay, the 'mod_tpp' modifier is often used as a proxy for cross-linking/structural proteomics in some routing schemas, or specifically for cross-linking if a dedicated 'mod_xl' is absent. The search parameters explicitly define a custom mass for BpA (251.0946 Da).

scope: The SPI complex and the mutant version were purified from cleared High Five cell lysates using a HisTrap FF column (Cytiva)
His-p97 was purified identically to the SPI complex via NiNTA affinity chromatography and anion exchange chromatography
Human p37 was generated from GST-p37 in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3)... cleared bacterial lysate was loaded onto a GSTrap column (Cytiva)
After incubation with the partner proteins, photocross-linking and tryptic digest the resulting cross-linked peptides were analysed by mass spectrometry.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed by MS consisted of reconstituted complexes of purified p97, p37, and the SPI complex (SDS22, PP1, and I3), all of which were isolated via affinity chromatography (NiNTA, GSTrap, HisTrap) prior to cross-linking and MS analysis.
